study.question: Does the strongest shared-context auxiliary-transfer variant require the native auxiliary excluded line beyond its norm, absolute overlap with the original carrier and the generic presence of a second excluded direction?
study.hypothesis: Observed: g3-r0030-joint_replay click AUC0.6684573079 exceeds click-only/aux-context-blocked0.6678548721, while batch-rolled labels score0.6674639466. In later surrogate-gradient branches, native-orthogonal and paired-tangent negative directions underperform their positive arms; fixed-carrier K/O-excluded negative instead reaches0.6688558745 versus positive0.6685951092 (g3-r0052), exactly replayed in rounds53/54. Removing only O exclusion (g3-r0054) gives negative0.6685156157 and positive0.6685764811, native advantages0.0003402588 and0.0000186281. But that also changes excluded rank from two to one, leaving a generic geometry explanation. Bit removal reverses the favored external sign (g3-r0053 positive0.6686452073 vs negative0.6683159780), so sign interaction matters. FP32 versus FP64 collection differed materially in g3-r0041, warning against numerical explanations masquerading as semantics. Proposed mechanism: the O exclusion carries useful task-conditioned geometry beyond arbitrary extra exclusion. Replace O by a second fixed coordinate carrier H, keep K exclusion, radius, Q bit, gates and both signs. All evidence is fixed-seed validation; no seed-general mechanism support, no new efficacy result, and no novelty established. Before host execution, a pure-integer sanity check on synthetic fully occupied8192x192 coordinates found centered raw-carrier cosine -0.27326971888631424. This is not a tensor/gradient or data result. The proposal was revised prospectively to match the excluded line norm and absolute overlap with F after removing K, preventing raw carrier correlation from becoming an uncontrolled projection-angle difference. No offset search or model training preceded this revision.

study.proposed_difference: A source-by-sign 2x2 changes only selected shared-context surrogate cotangent. Native bridges deliver +/-s(Q)*canon(project_{K,O-perp} F) at ||O||. For candidate, form E=unit(F after two-pass K projection) and U=unit(raw nuisance carrier after two-pass K/F projection). Raw nuisance uses the inherited modular-coordinate formula offset by prespecified104729. Set a=<O,E>, b=||O-aE||, H=|a|E+bU. H matches O norm and absolute overlap with E in FP64; it is invariant under O reversal and preserves the unoriented excluded-line angle. Candidates deliver +/-s(Q)*canon(project_{K,H-perp} F) at ||H||, equal to ||O|| up to roundoff. Require original active support plus new F/U/rank/tangent validity; failed cases are zero, never fallback directions. Every helper runs in every cell. Forward, capacity/private true-label losses and state code remain inherited. H retains auxiliary scalar norm/overlap/support and Q sign-bit information; this tests excluded directional information beyond those scalar properties, not label independence or isotropic noise. This surrogate VJP is not the derivative of the reported joint scalar BCE. No coordinate-offset tuning is planned.
